subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The tool was powerful, but it had no responsibility.”?
options: It asks whether every student can actually use it.
It made students notice growth, responsibility, and the quiet needs of living things.
The responsibility stayed with the student.
Understanding responsibility before choosing is harder.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It asks whether every student can actually use it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It made students notice growth, responsibility, and the quiet needs of living things.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The tool was powerful, but it had no responsibility. The responsibility stayed with the student.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Understanding responsibility before choosing is harder.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The tool was powerful, but it had no responsibility. The responsibility stayed with the student.」，答案為「The responsibility stayed with the student.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The responsibility stayed with the student.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
